name_input: M/S PANACEA BIOTECH LTD; M/S PANACEA BIOTEC LTD.; PANACEA BIOTEC LTD.; PANACEA BIOTEC LTD; M/S PANACEA BIOTEC LIMITED.; PANACEA BOITEC LTD.; PANACEA BIOTEC LTD; PANACEA BIOTECH LTD; PANACEA BIOTECH LTD.; PANACEA BIOTEC LIMITED; M/S. PANACEA BIOTEC LTD; PANACEA BIOTEC LIMITED
export_evidence: No shipment row could be read. importkey.com/countries/india/panacea-biotec-ltd returned only the page shell: "Shipments available for PANACEA BIOTEC LTD, refreshed daily" — 0 shipment rows visible (JS-rendered, counter shown as "Loading..."). volza.com, eximpedia.app, trademo.com and zauba.com returned HTTP 403; importgenius.com returned a JavaScript challenge. No bill-of-lading number, date, destination or HS code was obtained from any customs source. Company-side claim only (not evidence of shipment): panaceabiotec.com states it supplied WHO pre-qualified polio vaccine "in 50+ countries worldwide" — declared, not confirmed by a customs record.
domestic_evidence: Listed Indian company with audited consolidated revenue, i.e. actual domestic/overall sales exist. Screener.in (BSE: 531349 / NSE: PANACEABIO) consolidated P&L: "Mar 2026 ... Sales 640" and "TTM 721" (Rs crore), with quarterly sales e.g. "Sep 2026 190". Company site confirms legal identity: "Panacea Biotec Limited | (CIN: L33117PB1984PLC022350) Regd. Office: Ambala-Chandigarh Highway, Lalru – 140501, Punjab". Note: the P&L does not split domestic vs export turnover in the free view, so the domestic share is not public here; GSTIN-level turnover band not retrieved.
note: Legal entity exists and is active (CIN L33117PB1984PLC022350, listed on BSE/NSE) — no grounds for rejection. Declared HS 300241 (vaccines for human medicine) is consistent with the company's actual product line (polio/pentavalent/hexavalent vaccines), so no HS correction is needed; the claimed industry label "Нефтегаз и химия" (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — this is a pharma/biotech manufacturer, not a trader. Revenue: FY2026 consolidated sales Rs 640 crore, TTM Rs 721 crore (Screener.in). Export volume in USD/value and shipment count: null — not public in accessible free sources. Export status is 'unknown', not 'confirmed': the company's own website and press releases claim multi-country vaccine supplies, but no dated customs/B-L record with destination and HS code could be retrieved (all four free shipment databases blocked or JS-only). Domestic supply is confirmed by audited revenue, but the domestic/export split is not disclosed in the free data. No traces of specific shipment records were found in accessible sources — this is a data-access limitation, not evidence of absence.
